name: slicc-bios-optional
description: The optional packages that seven pins because their publisher isn't homescoop's ladder: slicc-jsh, mcpcat, wasi-slicc (slicc-cli) and sliccy-browser (slicc-cdp). Release-state and cert review certify these pins; every other catalog entry is npm's latest behind the runtime gate. Never installed as a project: the panel runs pnpm add -g for each one.
